proposition.claim:
Printed path-pair composition violates identity law and the stated embedding functor convention.

Printed exceptional block fails R2 Hermiticity.

Two boundary blocks violate U^2=[2]U under admissible graph parameters.

p_Lambda(N+1) normalization divides by zero at permitted level k=1.

Cyclic product decomposition used for Galois lifting is false without coprimality.

B gauge formula omits N-2 edge factors, unlike its proof diagram.

Y=U/q-id has eigenvalues -1,q^-2, not -1,q^2.
